query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM products WHERE tenant=$1 AND ((extra->'currencyPrices') ?| $2 OR extra->>'priceCurrency'=ANY($2))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM currency_price_jobs WHERE tenant=$1 AND state='queued' AND data->>'currency'=ANY($2)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM carts WHERE tenant=$1 AND status='open' AND data->>'currency'=ANY($2)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b2b_units WHERE tenant=$1 AND data->>'currency'=ANY($2)) AS "in_use!"
